56dbe0d041559c5f.description: **About AptEdge** We build AI agents for B2B technical support. The agent pulls from everything a support org already has (tickets, docs, CRM, chat, bugs, codebase) and works a case the way a good senior engineer would, from investigation to resolution. We live inside the tools support teams already use: Zendesk, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Slack, Jira, Confluence. Backed by top VCs and Founders. **The Role** Every customer we sign has to go from contract to a working, trusted AI agent workflow, and you're the person who gets them there. You'll set up their integrations, tune what the agent can see and say, write the runbooks that tell it how that customer resolves a given class of ticket, and stay close enough afterward to know when something has drifted. Most of that is configuration. Some of it is code, and when it is, you'll write it yourself rather than filing a ticket and waiting. You'll be part of our Customer Success org, because the role is evaluated on whether customers adopt, expand, and renew. You'll also spend time working with the R&D team. When you find something in a deployment that's a product problem and not a config problem, you should be able to walk over and fix it, or at least get it fixed fast. **What You'll Work On** **Getting customers live** Setting up integrations, SSO and SAML, IT and systems administration, and checking that what we’re integrated with is actually what they meant to give us. Co-ordinate with customers and admin/IT teams over calls and async to run enablement. **Customizing the product** Overall setup, prompt engineering, search filters, ranking, how answers get formatted, branding, embeds. Whatever it takes to make AptEdge feel native to that customer. **Data understanding and engineering** Sometimes it's the source data. Sometimes it's indexing, a filter, or a prompt. You'll trace it through pipelines, logs, and the database and fix the layer that's actually broken. **Technical Prompt Engineering** Work on a live LLM powered platform that empowers very technical engineers and agents to deliver business value. Understand data in depth to understand build agentic workflows and pipelines. **Writing some code** Building and fixing connectors, self-service features, ingestion for the odd knowledge sources customers throw at us, and internal tooling so the third time we do a customization it's a setting instead of a project. **Monitoring and optimizing customer health** Reporting on usage and resolution per account, alongside CS. You'll see a stalled deployment before the customer does and know how to unstick it. **Growing accounts** You'll own the technical half of expansion: scoping new use cases, discovering value, empowering business partners, and coordinating with internal go-to-market and engineering teams. **You Need** * 5+ years in solutions, implementation, and backend engineering at a B2B SaaS company * To have supported an LLM or RAG product that real customers used in production * Solid Python and TypeScript, and comfort working in a large codebase in collaboration with engineering teams * Hands-on experience with enterprise identity (SAML, OAuth2, SSO) and third-party APIs, including the ugly parts: rate limits, webhooks, eventual consistency, prompt engineering & testing * Clear written and spoken English to communicate with customers and IT/engineering teams. * Availability for customer calls through US working hours. The rest of your day is yours to arrange. * Experience with cloud and debugging tools such as GCP/AWS, Sentry, PagerDuty, etc. **It Helps If You Have** * Admin or config experience in Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, or ServiceNow * Direct experience supporting live, production-grade retrieval-augmented generation systems * Background with Kubernetes or React web applications * A feel for the commercial side. You know adoption is what drives renewal, and you can tell a customer who's stuck from one who's just not using it * A habit of owning problems from beginning to end, including identifying opportunities to be proactive in support of customer or internal goals. * Previous working experience as a Support Engineer **How We Work** * Small team, high ownership. Small PRs, and we pair when a problem is hard * Customer-facing engineers ship code here. Your work goes in the main repo and gets reviewed as per engineering contribution process * CS and R&D look at the same customer data. You'll be in both rooms and carry context between them

Project Description:

We are seeking a Business Analyst to bridge business requirements and technical delivery across integration, data, and enterprise software projects. The role involves working closely with stakeholders and delivery teams to understand business needs, define solution requirements, support Agile development activities, and ensure successful implementation through testing and validation.

Location: Bangalore (Remote)

How You'll Make an Impact:

• Engage with stakeholders to gather, analyse, and document business, functional, and system requirements.
• Translate business needs into detailed functional specifications, business rules, process workflows, and data-mapping documents.
• Act as the key liaison between business users, project teams, and technical teams to ensure alignment throughout the project lifecycle.
• Maintain traceability between business objectives, solution design, development activities, test cases, and delivered outcomes.
• Support Agile delivery practices, including backlog refinement, requirement prioritization, sprint planning, and collaboration with cross-functional teams.
• Perform data analysis and validation activities using SQL to support requirement discovery, impact assessments, and solution verification.
• Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including test scenario preparation, defect management, and business sign-off activities.
• Identify process improvement opportunities and provide recommendations that enhance operational efficiency and solution effectiveness.
• Contribute to the successful delivery of enterprise applications, system integrations, and data-driven solutions while ensuring business expectations are met.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

• 4+ years of Business Analysis experience supporting enterprise software, integration, or data-focused projects.
• Proven ability to elicit requirements and convert complex business challenges into clear, actionable solution specifications.
• Strong expertise in business process analysis, documentation, functional requirements definition, and data-mapping activities.
• Working knowledge of SQL for data analysis, validation, and troubleshooting.
• Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating with product owners, developers, testers, and business stakeholders.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail and delivering high-quality outcomes.
• Experience in regulated industries is a plus.
• Excellent verbal and written English communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

What We Offer:

• Competitive salary;
• Opportunities for professional growth and advancement;
• A cooperative and innovative work environment;
• 20 days of paid vacation, 15 paid sick days;
• Medical insurance coverage for employees, with optional family coverage at a corporate rate;
• Support for participation in professional development opportunities (webinars, conferences, trainings, etc.);
• Regular team-building activities and biannual company-wide events.
